name: SDFPerf Raymarching Shader
definition: A node-based editor for creating and manipulating signed-distance fields (SDFs) that generates a raymarching shader string from a graph of operators. Supports basic SDF primitives (spheres, cubes, planes, toruses), domain manipulation (translations, scales, bends, twists), and CSG operations (unions, intersections, differences, smooth-minimums).
summary: SDFPerf Raymarching Shader is a fragment shader generated from a node-based graph editor that constructs Signed Distance Functions using basic primitives, CSG operations, and domain manipulations.
